rules.description: Applicant must be pregnant or have given birth within the last 12 months
rules.reason_if_failed: This exemption is only for people who are pregnant or have had a baby in the last 12 months

rules.description: Applicant must be eligible for NHS care
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be ordinarily resident in the UK to receive free NHS prescriptions and dental treatment

rules.description: Applicant must be registered with a GP or have a midwife
rules.reason_if_failed: You need to be registered with a GP or have a midwife to confirm your pregnancy

rules.description: If pregnant, due date must be in the future (within reasonable timeframe)
rules.reason_if_failed: The due date provided appears to be in the past. Please provide your baby's birth date instead.

edge_cases.description: Applicant has experienced miscarriage or stillbirth
edge_cases.action: Exemption continues for 12 months from date of pregnancy loss. Route to sensitive support pathway.

edge_cases.description: Applicant is pregnant with twins or multiples
edge_cases.action: Standard MatEx applies. No special documentation needed.
12-month exemption starts from actual birth date, not due date.

edge_cases.description: Applicant already receives free prescriptions for another reason
edge_cases.action: Inform applicant they may already be covered. MatEx provides additional dental coverage.
